title: Shield Predictability Upgrade (v3.2.1)
summary: Shield behavior became more dependable during active sessions, especially in harder distraction moments.

fixes: Strengthened distraction monitoring in tougher cases

bodyMarkdown:
## Highlights

- Improved Shield reliability during focus sessions

## Fixes

- Strengthened distraction monitoring in tougher cases
- Added accessibility improvements across multiple screens
- Improved UI consistency in different parts of the app

## Why this matters

Shield Predictability Upgrade (v3.2.1) is one of those tidy-up releases that does not need a parade, but it still helps the Shield feel less fussy. Small fixes matter here because CogniFocus is supposed to get out of your way fast. Tap in, start the thing, dodge the scroll spiral, continue your tiny heroic quest. That is the whole deal.

- Improved Shield reliability during focus sessions gets a little more room to breathe.
- Strengthened distraction monitoring in tougher cases gets a little more room to breathe.
- Added accessibility improvements across multiple screens gets a little more room to breathe.
- Improved UI consistency in different parts of the app gets a little more room to breathe.

So yes, this is a smaller note. The point is still real: fewer weird little moments, clearer feedback, and less friction between you and the session you meant to start. The Goblin may still be dramatic about it, obviously, but the app should feel calmer where it counts.
